liturgicalName: The Nativity of the Lord (Christmas Day)
keyVerseDR: "And the Word was made flesh and dwelt among us..." (Jn 1:14)

level1.title: Jesus Is Born!
level1.story: Jesus is the Word of God. He was with God from the beginning. At Christmas, He became a baby to live with us!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What gift can you give Jesus?
level1.prayer: Baby Jesus, thank You for coming. Amen.

activity.title: The Christmas star
activity.intro: Draw the other half of the star.

level2.title: The Word Became Flesh
level2.story: "In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God." All things were made by Him. In Him was life, and the life was the light of men. To all who received Him, He gave power to become children of God. "And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, and we saw His glory."
level2.keyLine: The Word was made flesh and dwelt among us.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does 'the Word was made flesh' mean?
How can you be a light to others?
level2.prayer: Jesus, Word made flesh, shine in my heart. Amen.

activity.title: Our Father
activity.intro: Jesus came to make us children of God. Number the phrases of the Our Father.
pieces: Our Father, who art in heaven,
on earth as it is in heaven.
